name: Dead of Winter: The Long Night

categories.label: Colony main objective completed
categories.hint: Checked only if the game ended by completing it; if morale or the round track hit 0 the main objective is skipped.

categories.label: Own secret objective completed
categories.labelVi: Hoàn thành mục tiêu bí mật
categories.hint: Each player checks their own secret objective (including betrayer or exiled variants).

categories.label: Player wins
categories.hint: A player wins if they completed their own secret objective when the game ends; several players may win, or none.

winCondition: The game ends when morale reaches 0, the round track reaches 0, or the main objective is completed. When it ends for any reason, each player who completed their own secret objective wins and the rest lose, so several players can win or everyone can lose.

endCondition.description: Morale 0, round track 0, or main objective completed.

roles.label: Survivor
roles.winCondition: Completes own secret objective when the game ends

roles.label: Betrayer / exiled
roles.labelVi: Kẻ phản bội / bị trục xuất
roles.winCondition: Completes own betrayal or exile secret objective

notes: family: coop. Hidden objectives; no points. The Long Night adds exiled secret objectives, despair tokens and first-player votes (not modelled). Rules checked on secondary summaries (Ultra BoardGames base-game page and RulesPal Long Night page); the official rulebook PDF could not be retrieved.
